rates.rate_method_note: Zip average equals the unweighted mean of the 3 utilities listed, not the utility that actually serves a given address

data_quality_flags: eRedux zip rate for 87013 (15.97) averages 3 utilities equally; most of Cuba is served by JMEC (15.36). Confirm the serving utility per area.
eRedux lists 87013 in eGRID NWPP while nearby 87025 and 87124 are AZNM; check this in the EPA Power Profiler.
eRedux 87013 rooftop estimate (2,385 kWh/yr for 6 kW) is implausibly low; use NREL PVWatts instead.
eRedux Sandoval heating fuel shows only gas, electricity, fuel oil (86.9%); propane and wood are missing.
eRedux NM EV ports: Level 2 + DC fast = 1,316 but total shown as 1,330.
eRedux NM generation mix sums to 101.8%.
eRedux gasoline and heating fuel prices are labeled Gulf Coast region, not New Mexico.
87013 heating fuel (64% wood) comes from ACS with only 1,586 housing units; check the margin of error in B25040.
